photos.c: Second from left: Youngest man in the team, Jonathan Blackledge set the 8th fastest short stage time of the day and increased our lead by a minute.

Bottom right: The victorious Belgrave crew can't stop smiling after retaining their title. Standing: Jonathan Blackledge (stage 6), Al Stewart (11), Kevin Nash (3), Adam Zawadski (12), Martin Dent (7), Paul Freary (1), Paul Evans (9 - and what proved to be his last team run for Belgrave), David Anderson (4). Kneeling: Allen Graffin (5), Will Cockerell (10), Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward (8), Stephen Sharp (2).
Above: David Anderson, Martin Dent, Will Cockerell, Jonathan Blackledge, Stephen Sharp, Paul Freary - delighted to hold onto the Ian Logan Memorial Bowl for another year.

Above: Stephen Sharp (stage 6), Phil Wicks (2), Jonathan Blackledge (5), Spencer Barden (4), Alaster Stewart (1) and Tim Watson (3) receive the Ian Logan Trophy – Belgrave’s fourth year of being top of the pile at Rushmoor Arena.  Only Stephen and Jonathan remained in the squad from 2004’s winning line-up.

Jonathan Blackledge added his name to a distinguished list of winners in the Varsity Race – a list including Chris Chataway, Roger Bannister, Richard Nerurkar and many other notables.  Photo by Alan Mead.

One lap into the Senior Men’s 4 km race and the front rank includes Mark Warmby (4934 Newham & Essex Beagles), Jonathan Blackledge (4880 Belgrave), Steve Vernon (4933 Stockport), Tom Payne (4913 Birchfield), Chris Moss (4907 Belgrave), Darren Gauson (Belgrave, behind Moss), Angus McLean (4909 Team Southampton), and just obscured behind McLean is Chris Thompson (Aldershot F&D).

Above: The start of the Eastleigh 10k on March 19th.  The race included the CAU Inter-Counties Championship and Belgravians were racing in some unfamiliar vests.  In the red vest with white/red shorts towards the left is the eventual race winner Angus Maclean (Team Southampton). 31 is Richard Ward (Belgrave/Surrey), 32 Phil Wicks (Belgrave/Surrey), between and just behind  these latter two is Tim Watson in a white/green vest (Belgrave/Hampshire).  To the right of Phil is Hassan Raidi (Belgrave/Surrey), Jonathan Blackledge (Belgrave), and 15 Jermain Mays (Kent AC/Kent).  Maclean's winning time was 29:47, Mays was second in 30:00 and Phil Wicks 3rd in 30:02.  Belgrave won the team race and Surrey the Inter-County Championship. Full result and report in the previous issue.  Photo by Steve Wicks.

Happy with a seventh successive year in the medals at the National Road Relay. Standing (left to right) Gerry North, Gordon Biscoe, Bill Laws, Brian Pritchard, Tom Osment, Maureen Pritchard, Zara Chidoub, Mark Pollard, Jonathan Blackledge, Janet Blackledge, Mike Blackledge, Neil Speaight, Alan Mead, Padraic Buckley, Paul Freary, Eric Hall, Pete Willis, Hazel Mead. Front row. Mavis Hall, Charles Jones, Richard Ward, Simon Jones, Malachi Byansi, Will Cockerell, Pat Mead, Phil Wicks.
